subject: Purchase order constraints & milestone-billing carveouts — Harvesta Health
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maggie Turner <maggie.turner@harvesta-health.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Purchase order constraints & milestone-billing carveouts — Harvesta Health

Maggie — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a couple of asks so our finance team can draft final pricing:  

- Harvesta requires a PO with the following mandatory fields: PO number, billing entity (entity id), cost center code, and remit address. Please confirm the exact field name used in your ERP for the cost center (e.g., "BU Code" vs "CostCenterID").
- You mentioned Net60 was Procurement's default. Our standard commercial terms are Net30; we can offer a concession (discount) for Net45 or a larger one for Net30 upfront. Would Harvesta consider Net45 with a 4% discount vs Net60 at no discount?
- Harvesta wants invoice cadence tied to milestones: 40% on kickoff, 40% at completion of onboarding (first 30 days), and 20% at 90-day review. We can support milestone invoices, but we need PO-level routing to ensure invoices map to the right BU.

Attached: Redwood_Quote_0427.xlsx (line-item pricing) and a draft SOW for milestone triggers. If you can send a sample PO from your system (redacted), we’ll validate field mapping to avoid AP rejects.

Next steps: if you can confirm the PO field names and whether Net45 is acceptable, I’ll route a formal amendment for signature.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_Quote_0427.xlsx (Excel), SOW-Redwood-Harvesta-v1.pdf (PDF)

From: Maggie Turner <maggie.turner@harvesta-health.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@harvesta-health.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase order constraints & milestone-billing carveouts — Harvesta Health

Camila — thanks for the summary. A few clarifications from Procurement:  

- Our ERP requires the PO to include: PO_NUMBER, BILL_TO_ENTITY (legal name), BU_CODE (4-digit), REMIT_ADDRESS, and TAX_ID. We use "BU_CODE" in all supplier integrations.
- Net60 is standard for Harvesta unless a commercial discount is explicitly approved by our Finance Director. Net45 requires an approval memo; Net30 would need senior finance sign-off and a volume commitment.
- The milestone breakdown you suggested is fine, but we will only accept separate invoices if the PO has the correct BU_CODE mapping and each invoice references the corresponding milestone tag (MILESTONE_1, MILESTONE_2, MILESTONE_3).

I'll attach a redacted example PO and our vendor onboarding checklist in a follow-up. Please provide Redwood's legal entity name and remit address exactly as it should appear on the PO, plus the tax id.

Thanks,
Maggie Turner
Senior Procurement Manager | Harvesta Health
maggie.turner@harvesta-health.com

On Thu, Apr 29, 2027 at 09:12 AM Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Maggie — thanks again for the call this morning...

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maggie Turner <maggie.turner@harvesta-health.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase order constraints & milestone-billing carveouts — Harvesta Health

Maggie — appreciated. Quick answers and proposal:  

1) Legal/remit details for PO: 
   - Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - Remit address: 1201 Market St, Suite 1800, San Francisco, CA 94103
   - Tax ID: 94-1234567

2) BU_CODE mapping: we can emit the BU_CODE on every invoice as a header field. Please confirm the exact 4-digit formatting (zero-pad?). We'll validate with a sanitized PO sample when you send it.

3) Terms & discount proposal: to bridge the Net60 ask, Redwood can do the following options — pick one that aligns with Harvesta’s approval path:  
   A) Net45 with a 4% contract-level discount (applies to all invoice line items).
   B) Net60 with standard pricing but a 2% early-pay (within 15 days) incentive on each invoice.
   C) Net30 at 7% discount with a 12-month minimum committed spend (tiered credits).

Option A is our recommended middle ground and is the fastest to approve on our side.

4) Milestone invoicing: we’ll tag invoices with MILESTONE_1/2/3 and include PO_NUMBER and BU_CODE in the invoice header. Our billing team (cc: Ben Carter) can accept an initial invoice via email once we have your PO sample.

If you send the redacted PO and onboarding checklist, I’ll run this through Finance tomorrow and attach an amendment reflecting your selected terms.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Quote_0427.xlsx

From: Maggie Turner <maggie.turner@harvesta-health.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@harvesta-health.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase order constraints & milestone-billing carveouts — Harvesta Health

Camila/Vanessa — thanks for the details and the options. Procurement had a quick look and Finance prefers Option B (Net60 + 2% early-pay incentive) as it avoids additional approval steps. Two asks before we finalize:  

- Can Redwood confirm that splitting invoices across the three milestones will not trigger multiple tax jurisdictions or require separate W9s? If there are tax implications we need to escalate.
- Please send a clean amendment (Word/PDF) that includes Option B language and the milestone invoice tags so our legal team can sign off.

If you can get the amendment over today, we can route for signature next week and issue the PO (redacted sample attached).

Regards,
Maggie Turner
Senior Procurement Manager | Harvesta Health
